snippet.title: RAGDORE - Trailer | New Game With Gore Physics | v 0.1
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860100/RAGDORE/
Play Market/AppStore version will be released on the same date

\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7sxHtT8g🎮👌
\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\

RAGDORE is a single-player physics sandbox where damage isn't just decoration—it's the whole point...

🦴 Tear apart a fully simulated character: break bones, rip off limbs, get crushed, stabbed, or blown up—while movement dynamically adjusts to what's left of your body. Stumble with broken legs, crawl with no arms, or crawl across the floor with whatever's left of you.

🔧 RAGDORE offers 3 sandbox maps at launch:

Ragdoll Park – a colorful playground of giant slides and ramps designed for chaotic ragdoll tumbling.

Crazy Mountain – a high-altitude fall map for pure ragdoll carnage.

Polygon Map – a dense industrial testing facility packed with interactive hazards: crushers, shredders, spike traps, trampolines, explosive barrels, saws, and more.


🎮 There's no set goal – just raw experimentation and chaotic fun with physics-based destruction. No plot. No goal. Just chaos🙌

🔨 Features:

Fully simulated character damage & movement
Carefully placed map hazards like crushers, saws, and trampolines
A dummy NPC for testing and creative abuse
Stylized visuals with realistic physical reactions

Whether you're launching your character into a shredder or crawling away without limbs, RAGDORE turns pain into pure entertainment.
